About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Overview

Reporting to the Head of Digital, the Senior Manager, Web will lead Neo4j’s web strategy and execution across a global digital ecosystem. This critical role blends strategic vision with analytical precision and strong stakeholder management to ensure Neo4j’s web presence delivers a cohesive, high-performing experience that advances brand, engagement, and conversion goals.

You will define and drive the web strategy, leveraging data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration to evolve our website into a dynamic growth engine. The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, with expertise spanning digital strategy, analytics, UX optimization, and project execution.

Key Responsibilities

Web Strategy & Stakeholder Management

  • Develop and own the overarching web strategy that aligns with Neo4j’s marketing and business goals — encompassing web architecture, navigation, content structure, and UX best practices.
  • Ensure consistency and continuity in design, layout, and messaging across all pages and regions.
  • Conduct competitive analysis to identify emerging digital trends, innovative approaches, and opportunities to enhance our online presence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Content, Design, Operations, and Regional Marketing to align web priorities with business objectives.
  • Present strategy and results to stakeholders and leadership, using data to articulate rationale, performance, and recommendations.
  • Serve as the key liaison between digital, marketing, and product teams, balancing business needs, brand integrity, and user experience.

Project Management & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end management of web-related projects and initiatives — from intake and planning to execution and launch.
  • Oversee project pipelines, ensuring all stakeholders provide necessary inputs, assets, and approvals.
  • Manage timelines, scope, and deliverables, maintaining transparency through effective communication and project documentation.
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams, tracking progress and proactively resolving blockers.
  • Champion operational excellence within the digital team by optimizing workflows and standardizing processes.

Web Analytics & Performance Optimization

  • Leverage web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker, Data Studio) to monitor site performance, engagement, and conversion across key pages and funnels.
  • Analyze user journeys, engagement patterns, and conversion metrics to inform decision-making and continuously optimize the site.
  • Partner with analytics and content teams to establish KPIs for traffic, engagement, and conversion, and report on progress through regular dashboards and presentations.
  • Evaluate page and campaign launches using quantitative (heat maps, click maps, funnel analysis) and qualitative (feedback, session recordings) insights to improve performance over time.
  • Translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance UX and business impact.

A/B Testing & Optimization Roadmap

  • Develop and execute a test-and-learn agenda focused on improving traffic quality, engagement, and conversion rates.
  • Design and oversee A/B and multivariate testing initiatives — from hypothesis to experiment design, execution, and insights.
  • Partner with analytics and UX to prioritize tests that deliver measurable impact and contribute to a culture of continuous optimization.
  • Document learnings and socialize best practices across teams to inform broader digital and marketing efforts.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of experience in web, digital marketing, or product management, ideally within a B2B or SaaS environment.
  • Proven ability to develop strategy and lead cross-functional alignment for complex digital ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of web analytics and performance optimization; fluent in GA4, tag management, dashboards, and conversion tracking.
  • Strong familiarity with A/B testing tools (e.g., Optimizely, Google Optimize, VWO) and SEO/SEM principles.
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to translate data and strategy into clear, persuasive narratives.
  • Highly organized project manager experienced in agile workflows and tools like Asana or Jira.
  • Passionate about staying current with digital, UX, and web technology trends.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action, capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • A cohesive and scalable web strategy implemented across teams.
  • Clear data-driven visibility into performance and ROI of web initiatives.
  • A robust testing and optimization program driving measurable growth in engagement and conversions.
  • Smooth, on-time execution of projects with strong stakeholder alignment and communication.

Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Solutions EngineerAbout Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Buscamos un(a) Product Manager con visión estratégica, orientación técnica y fuerte capacidad analítica para liderar el desarrollo de productos basados en inteligencia artificial, especialmente mediante agentes autónomos, LLMs y plataformas de monetización de datos. Este perfil colaborará estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, ciencia de datos, negocio y desarrollo comercial (BDM), para diseñar soluciones que generen valor real en dominios como contabilidad, finanzas, nómina,

facturación o ecosistemas empresariales. El candidato ideal combinará conocimientos de mercado, experiencia construyendo productos de IA, y habilidades para traducir insights en propuestas viables, rentables y escalables.

Responsabilidades Principales

  • Definir la visión, estrategia y roadmap de productos de IA enfocados en agentes inteligentes, copilots y asistentes embebidos.
  • Analizar tendencias de mercado, competidores, necesidades del cliente y oportunidades de monetización en plataformas basadas en datos.
  • Trabajar junto a Business Development para co-crear propuestas de valor alineadas con necesidades de clientes B2B y B2B2C.
  • Colaborar con equipos técnicos para traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos funcionales y prioridades de desarrollo.
  • Identificar e integrar casos de uso viables para IA generativa y agentes en procesos críticos: automatización, recomendación, análisis, interacción.
  • Evaluar y definir modelos de monetización (consumo por API, licenciamiento, data-as-a- service, etc.).
  • Liderar procesos de discovery de producto, validación de hipótesis y entrevistas con usuarios clave.

Requirements

  • 4+ años de experiencia como Product Manager en soluciones tecnológicas o plataformas digitales.
  • Conocimiento sólido del ciclo de vida de productos de IA aplicada a negocio, incluyendo agentes, LLMs, NLP o modelos de recomendación.
  • Experiencia directa colaborando con Business Development o Strategy para definir modelos de ingreso, modelos de negocio, posicionamiento y monetización del producto o servicio.
  • Capacidad para realizar análisis de mercado, segmentación de usuarios y evaluación competitiva en contextos B2B o enterprise.
  • Habilidad para definir requerimientos funcionales claros y comunicarlos a equipos de ingeniería, IA y UX.
  • Experiencia trabajando en equipos ágiles y orientados a OKRs o KPIs.
  • Familiaridad con herramientas de diseño de producto (Jira, Notion, Figma, Miro) y análisis (Looker, Mixpanel, Google Analytics).
  • Inglés fluido a nivel técnico y de negocio.
  • Experiencia Implementando soluciones de IA conversacional con diferentes canales de IM (Whatsapp, Telegram, etc) y experiencia con modelos de pricing con esos canales
  • Experiencia en analisis y estudio de Mercado, estudio de competencia, etc.

Plus / Deseables (Nice to Have)

  • Conocimiento en monetización de datos, licenciamiento de modelos, o marketplaces de data/IA.
  • Experiencia previa en startups o scaleups AI-first.
  • Familiaridad con conceptos como LangChain, RAG, copilots empresariales, agentes autónomos o frameworks como CrewAI, AutoGen.
  • Conocimiento de productos relacionados con ERP, payroll, facturación, contabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Conocimiento básico de modelos de pricing de AI (token-based, tiered usage, performance-based).

Benefits

  • Desarrollo de productos innovadores con enfoque en IA y datos.
  • Cultura de buenas prácticas, arquitectura moderna y trabajo colaborativo.
  • Posibilidades de crecimiento técnico y formación continua.

jobs.description:
Credentialing AssistantThis position provides high quality support for credentialing functions within the health plan. Core responsibilities include records management, document management, and customer service as defined in CareOregon credentialing policies and procedures. This position works closely with the Credentialing Specialist and Credentialing Supervisor in the credentialing process to ensure all applications, primary source documentation, and notifications meet regulatory guidelines.

Estimated Hiring Range:

$20.89 - $25.54

Bonus Target:

Bonus - SIP Target, 5% Annual

Current CareOregon Employees: Please use the internal Workday site to submit an application for this job.

  • Keep records in a retrievable manner to support regulatory requirements.
  • Retrieve records as needed for activities such as document reviews and audits.
  • Coordinate and communicate with records management.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced mid- level in house Counsel.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced mid- level in house Counsel. You will be working closely with Mirantis’ General Counsel and legal team advising on a wide range of matters across the company, both US and international, in areas such as commercial transactions regarding AI enablement and open source space, vendor contracts privacy/data protection and more.

As a key member of the Mirantis legal team you will interface with all Mirantis team members to drive business results, manage risk, and help ensure compliance across all areas of the company. To do this you will need an entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to think strategically, influence stakeholders, and enthusiastically get in the trenches and execute when things need to get done.

This is a unique opportunity to join Mirantis at a critically strategic time in its open source cloud journey.

Job Description

  • Draft and implement transaction playbooks and integration checklists

  • Manage the company’s and its subsidiaries’ corporate legal affairs domestically and internationally

  • Draft, negotiate, and review a broad range of commercial and vendor agreements, mostly from the U.S. but may also include international exposure.

  • Review Vendor and contractor agreements

  • Assist Data Protection Officer in review and update of Data Processing Addenda and other documents.

  • Support training efforts to educate internal teams on legal standards and regulatory expectations

  • Work cross functionally with business teams across the company to analyze legal risks, devise creative solutions and develop strong, trusted advisor relationships.

  • Collaborate with General Counsel to update templates.

  • Partner with sales, channel sales, services, training, and product teams to help craft deals that conform with Mirantis practices and customer requirements while ensuring obligations are clearly documented.

  • Experience reviewing, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, including but not limited to software licenses (SaaS and on premises), professional services, reseller and referral agreements, and vendor/supplier contracts. Familiarity with open source and AI is preferred.
  • Understanding of intellectual property, licensing, SaaS, revenue recognition, privacy and other legal matters that arise in the connect of commercial transactions.
  • Strong commercial sensibilities, and ability to work closely with business people on their terms, and to negotiate some commercial terms as well as legal terms. Strong contract analysis, drafting and negotiation skills. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
  • 3-5 years’ overall legal experience. At least 3 years’ experience negotiating commercial contracts, preferably in an in-house role with a software (SaaS or open source) or technology-oriented company.
  • Able to provide quick, concise and practical advice consistent with Mirantis business objectives and processes, while ensuring business needs are met.
  • Able to work and act decisively in a fast-paced, high activity environment; comfortable in managing and responding to messages quickly and balancing multiple deals at one time.
  • Team attitude that no job is too big or too small. Strategic and pragmatic thinking.
  • Excellent judgment, attention to detail and ability to work both independently and as part of a team are a must; strong organizational, project management and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience supporting business units in Canada, EU or APAC is a plus.
  • Experience representing mature private and public companies
  • Experience with complex corporate structures and transactions, including cross-border transactions
  • Ability to adapt and be responsive to rapid developments and changes in direction as well as work with technologies, products, and on novel legal issues

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • In-house counsel experience
  • Ability to register as in-house counsel in California
  • Experience working for a top-tier law firm
  • Experience representing mature private and public companies
  • Experience with complex corporate structures and transactions, including cross-border transactions
  • Ability to adapt and be responsive to rapid developments and changes in direction as well as work with technologies, products, and on novel legal issues

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be admitted to the bar, in good standing, in at least one U.S. State.
  • Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

jobs.excerpt: Toloka AI supports frontier model post-training by building domain-specific reinforcement learning environments, tasks, and evaluation frameworks designed by real practitioners.
jobs.description:
Toloka AI supports frontier model post-training by building domain-specific reinforcement learning environments, tasks, and evaluation frameworks designed by real practitioners.

Mindrift, powered by Toloka — a leading enterprise AI and machine learning data partner since 2014 — connects top domain experts with cutting-edge AI initiatives. Backed by Toloka’s deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Eligible firms: McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain & Company, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte (Deloitte S&C), EY-Parthenon, Kearney, and Strategy& (PwC).

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.
  • Design structured consulting tasks for AI agents — break projects into discrete tasks that mirror real consulting work: market sizing, commercial due diligence, cost optimization, growth strategy, operational diagnosis, benchmarking, and more.
  • Define evaluation criteria and quality standards — develop grading frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and golden-answer solutions for each task, used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale.

This is a remote, project-based, individual-contributor role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

Skills & Requirements

  • 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte, EY-Parthenon, Kearney, or Strategy&
  • Strong structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking
  • Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps and deliverables
  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 25-30 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewNakupuna Federal is seeking a Senior Business/Functional Analyst to join our team of talented consultants providing Contractor Support Services (CSS) to the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC).
jobs.description:
Overview

Nakupuna Federal is seeking a Senior Business/Functional Analyst to join our team of talented consultants providing Contractor Support Services (CSS) to the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC). Support under this contract includes technical services supporting application development efforts to modernize NAVSUP supply and logistics applications and manage associated technical debt. The Senior Business/Functional Analyst will provide functional and business analysis expertise throughout the software development lifecycle and work closely with Government and contractor team members in an Agile delivery environment.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons:

  • Provide functional knowledge and subject matter expertise for assigned applications and perform assigned application support activities.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and maintain business and functional requirements obtained from customers, users, and other stakeholders.
  • Create, update, and maintain work items in the Enterprise Platform, currently AzDO, ensuring activities and supporting information are accurately documented and kept current within five business days.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM to decompose requirements and stories into work that can reasonably be completed within a sprint, generally within 10–15 business days and assist in defining Acceptance Criteria and the sprint Definition of Done.
  • Identify and document the tasks required to successfully complete Product Backlog Items (PBIs) in AzDO.
  • Develop PBI estimates and project roadmaps in support of project requirements, priorities, and schedules.
  • Establish and maintain traceability and dependencies between requirements, including Epics, Features, PBIs, Stories, Tasks, and associated systems, within AzDO.
  • Work closely with the Government to continually maintain the Product Backlog in alignment with the Agile cadence, ensuring necessary Release and Sprint Backlog items are defined with Acceptance Criteria and available for Government prioritization before the start of each release and sprint.
  • Support development priorities in accordance with the Program Backlog.
  • Adhere to Scrum best practices and participate in recommended Scrum Events and Artifacts in accordance with the 2020 Scrum Guide, Agile Kanban practices, or other Agile or Scrum practices approved by the Government PO.
  • Effectively facilitate and participate in Scrum and Agile events and practices.
  • Support the full range of System/Software Development Lifecycle activities, including requirements, analysis, design, development, testing, security, and deployment.
  • Coordinate analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment activities necessary to complete assigned stories in accordance with Acceptance Criteria and the Definition of Done.
  • Propose Minimum Viable Product (MVP) solutions that provide an initial capability to end users while enabling user feedback to influence future development sprints.
  • Develop documentation in accordance with Agile Scrum best practices and the NAVSUP BSC Service Delivery Model.
  • Identify, define, or modify interfaces with other systems and applications and ensure agreements with interfacing systems/applications are formally documented.
  • Analyze system requirements and translate functional designs into detailed logic sufficient to support coding of assigned software systems, modules, and components.
  • Review individual modules and overall system designs for validity, including validation of record input, data elements, and output reports.
  • Perform required testing based on established Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done to verify software and system quality and functionality.
  • Prepare release packages for Government approval.
  • Provide pre-implementation training resources to customers and users.
  • Support the resolution of Production Outages.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM and SM to define and deliver metrics supporting project objectives. Metrics may include release burnup, sprint burndown, planned versus accepted PBI estimates, escaped defects, velocity, and other evolving measures, with a maximum of 10 metrics per team.
  • Provide comprehensive application Transfer of Knowledge to NAVSUP BSC application team personnel through concise, shop-usable lesson plans and other appropriate knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Actively provide daily mentoring to Government team members while performing assigned activities to increase Government personnel knowledge and familiarity with analyst tasks and support independent performance of similar future activities.
  • Support documentation of mentoring and knowledge-transfer activities for inclusion in monthly progress reports.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess strong business and functional analysis capabilities and have experience operating as part of an Agile application development team. Specifically, the candidate should possess the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Demonstrated ability to elicit, document, analyze, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Knowledge and practical experience with Agile concepts, principles, practices, and team-based delivery.
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools and techniques, including SQL and Microsoft Excel.

We are seeking a biostatistician with strong experience in real-world data (RWD) with observational study design and safety study experience in addition to RWE Safety experience.   • External control arm development and borrowing strategies

  • Observational study design

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Vendor Management Program Manager to lead the execution of our third-party risk management framework. This role is the backbone of our vendor oversight, ensuring that every partnership—from non-critical services to complex bank integrations—aligns with our high standards for security, compliance, and operational excellence. You will have the authority to manage the vendor lifecycle and ensure our program remains robust under regulatory scrutiny.

Compensation

The compensation range for the role is $5,000 - $6,500 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

What You'll Do:

  • Standards & Governance: work cross-functionally with IT, Legal, and Compliance teams to establish and maintain third-party risk standards and governance practices.
  • Due Diligence & Monitoring: Conduct comprehensive vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring activities, including evaluating consumer-impact risk, complaint analysis, and confirming privacy and data protection standards.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Manage third-party risk documentation and reporting, including maintaining the vendor and data processor inventory, ensuring timely onboarding and offboarding due diligence, and executing periodic compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment: Execute day-to-day risk assessments to determine vendor criticality and identify inherent risks in categories such as PII handling, BSA/AML, and credit decisioning.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Legal to ensure effective contracts are in place and with Information Security to validate the technical safeguards of our third-party partners.
  • Issue Escalation: Identify, track, and escalate risk events or performance failures to senior leadership and bank partners through established issue-tracking systems.

What We Look For:

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in vendor risk management, procurement, or third-party compliance, preferably within the fintech or regulated financial services industry.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of third-party risk management lifecycle and regulatory guidance (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GLBA, and BSA/AML).
  • Execution: Proven track record of managing a high volume of vendor assessments and maintaining a state of "audit-readiness" for bank partners and regulators.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About The Chicago School

The Chicago School educates the next generation of change-makers in innovative theory and culturally competent practice to strengthen the integrated health of individuals, organizations, and communities. Position Summary:

The Program Chair of the Master of Public Health (MPH) program is directly responsible to the Associate Dean within the college for the program. The Program Chair is a member of the faculty as an Administrative Faculty member and responsible for new student enrollment, faculty recruitment, scheduling and course sequencing, student affairs within the program, and student review process. The Program Chair works closely with Academic Leadership, Student Support, and Admissions.

The Program Chair will teach up to 12 credits per academic year. The Program Chair leads department meetings, participates in institutional and departmental committees, provides academic leadership, and performs duties as assigned by the Associate Dean and/or College Dean. As an administrative faculty member, the Program Chair is a member of the Faculty Council.

Main Key Areas of Responsibility

Program Growth and Development

  • Ensure ongoing compliance with Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH) accreditation and lead program review processes, working with Accreditation and Licensures, Associate Dean, and public health faculty and staff.
  • Lead continuous quality improvement (CQI) activities, including annual assessment planning, competency evaluation, systematic review of student learning outcomes, and implementation of improvement initiatives informed by assessment data and stakeholder feedback.
  • Identify, establish, and foster positive engagement across practice sites for Public Health faculty including initiation and maintenance of practice agreements in support of the Applied Practice Experience or Integrative Learning Experience required by CEPH.
  • Develop and execute a plan for community engagement in support of expanding awareness and driving new student enrollment at The Chicago School.
  • Establish and facilitate an active Public Health Advisory Board that engages community stakeholders, alumni, employers, and practice partners in continuous program improvement and workforce alignment.
  • Recruit, hire, and manage program faculty to support the institution's diverse student body from recruitment to matriculation, in alignment with budget allowances and university needs.
  • Collaborate with the admissions team to ensure timely review of admissions files and development of materials to support achievement of new student recruiting goals.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive student engagement initiatives that promote academic success, professional identity development, career readiness, alumni engagement, and lifelong connection to the program.

Academic Operations

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of the program to ensure quality student experience and faculty performance expectations are maintained.
  • Direct course scheduling in a manner that supports the student experience via ensuring adequate class size and assigning faculty who are properly credentialed and trained to deliver assigned course content.
  • Represent the department at meetings, student events, and other related events to facilitate collaborative decision making, student engagement, building program and university awareness in the community.
  • Lead the development of strategic academic and budget plans for the department, including recommendations from the assessment and department review process to inform student enrollment growth targets and program staffing needs.
  • Seek and implement opportunities to integrate emerging instructional technology into curriculum delivery models.

People Management

  • Build and manage a faculty team that is welcoming and supportive of diverse voices, new perspectives, and innovation at the institution.
  • Mentor, supervise and evaluate the teaching, advisement, and other duties performed by Faculty members to meet program academic goals.
  • Develop and apply a structured, data-driven system for mentoring, supervising and evaluating the teaching, advisement, and other duties performed by faculty members to ensure student achievement of program and institutional learning outcomes.
  • Ensure department faculty remain active in scholarship and service as evidenced by membership in institutional committee work, professional organizations, publications, presentations, and colloquia.

Academic Quality & Innovation

  • Ensure curriculum mapping, competency alignment, and assessment processes remain consistent with CEPH accreditation requirements, workforce expectations, and institutional learning outcomes.
  • Identify and pursue external funding opportunities, including grants, partnerships, and scholarships.
  • Monitor satisfactory academic progress supporting student progress through the curriculum and timely degree completion.
  • Ensure student concerns are effectively addressed in a timely and responsive manner in support of student satisfaction and retention.

Position Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree (DrPH, Ph.D., MD, or equivalent) in public health or closely related field from an accredited institution.
  • MPH degree or equivalent graduate training in public health.
  • Minimum three years of academic administration experience including working with students at the undergraduate or graduate level is strongly desired.
  • Strong scholarly background in research and publications, presenting at conferences, and conducting program assessments.
  • Demonstrated understanding of CEPH accreditation standards and processes.
  • Experience with online or distance education delivery.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified in Public Health (CPH) credential
  • Direct experience leading or participating in CEPH accreditation processes
  • Experience developing or directing graduate public health programs
  • Demonstrated success in curriculum development and assessment
  • Grant writing and external funding acquisition experience

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (UX) - Clearance Required
jobs.excerpt: About UsRed Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security.
jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

ABOUT DEFCON AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

About the Role

Asthe Senior Product Designer you will own complex product experiences from discovery through delivery for a new AI-enabled decision-support system. The work today is spread across several disconnected legacy systems, and we are replacing it with a single workspace: a prioritized work queue, a unified view that pulls scattered records together, enrichment panels, and dashboards.

Design sits in the product organization here, reporting through the Product Lead alongside product ownership and quality. You will partner daily with product and engineering to define scope, tradeoffs, and priorities, and you will support engineering through implementation rather than handing off and moving on.

This is a discovery-first role. Before anything is built you will interview and observe the people who do this work, map their current process, and design the future one. That becomes an interactive prototype the customer reviews and approves before production code is written, and it is an early program deliverable, so this work starts immediately. Design artifacts on this program are formally reviewed against written criteria, which means your work carries real weight from the first week.

The core design problem is trust. The system recommends what deserves attention and explains why, and your job is to present that so a user can evaluate it rather than simply accept it: showing the supporting evidence, making uncertainty visible, and making disagreement easy. You will work alongside an existing designer and with product, engineering, and data staff.

This is a hands-on role and a senior one. You are here to do the design work, and you will own how design gets done on this program: the research approach, the patterns, and the standard the work is held to. We are building out our design practice and the person in this seat shapes it. This is a fully remote role with occasional travel (up to 25%) to DEFCON AI HQ, customer sites, and vendor facilities as required.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery and Workflow Design

  • Run structured discovery with end users: interviews, shadowing sessions, and workflow observation
  • Produce current-state and future-state workflow maps that hold up to review by the people who do the work
  • Translate mission and operational needs into interaction designs, and know which constraints are real versus assumed
  • Deliver a fully interactive clickable prototype covering prioritized queues, enrichment panels, record history, and dashboards, as an early program deliverable

Interface and Interaction Design

  • Design the user workspace end to end: work queue, unified record view, evidence and enrichment panels, decision flow, record history, trend views, and operational dashboards
  • Apply and contribute to a design system so the interface stays coherent as scope grows across releases, and so components carry forward to other products rather than being rebuilt
  • Design for high-volume, repetitive work: keyboard efficiency, scannability, minimal context switching, and low error rates under time pressure
  • Design accessible interfaces that meet Section 508 and WCAG requirements
  • Identify gaps in the existing experience and propose improvements rather than waiting to be assigned them

Designing for AI Output

  • Present model recommendations, confidence, and supporting evidence so users can evaluate them rather than defer to them
  • Make uncertainty and gaps visible, including the case where the system returns insufficient evidence
  • Design the review and override path so disagreeing with the system is easy and the reason is captured
  • Design audit and traceability views so any conclusion can be traced back to its source records

Delivery Partnership

  • Partner closely with product and engineering from problem definition through launch, not just at handoff
  • Work directly with front-end engineers and hand off designs they can build from without guessing, and improve that handoff into a dependable pipeline rather than a recurring negotiation
  • Review builds against the design and hold the quality bar through implementation
  • Present design rationale clearly enough that stakeholders can follow the reasoning, not only the result
  • Iterate on real usage feedback, analytics, and acceptance-testing results across multiple releases
  • Support training and adoption materials as the system rolls out to a wider user cohort
  • Partner with the existing designer on the team so the two of you cover the program rather than duplicating
  • Help establish the design practices we do not have yet: repeatable research habits, reusable patterns, and a cleaner handoff to front-end engineering
  • Raise the work of designers around you through review and collaboration as the team grows

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product or UX design experience, with a portfolio of shipped, complex applications used by people doing real work every day
  • You have owned the design for a system like this before, end to end, from discovery through a shipped interface that users adopted. Please be prepared to discuss which system, what you owned, and how it turned out
  • You are the most senior designer in the room and comfortable there. This role sets the design direction rather than executing someone else's, and there is no design leadership above it to escalate to
  • You arrive with a method that already works. Design starts immediately on this program, so we are looking for someone who adapts a discovery and delivery approach they have run before rather than assembling one here
  • Demonstrated experience designing data-dense, workflow-heavy interfaces: role-based views, dashboards, data visualization, queues, and case or record views. This is enterprise software for people with layered permissions and real consequences, not marketing sites or consumer apps
  • Strong visual craft: layout, hierarchy, and typography, at a fidelity a stakeholder can review and approve
  • Direct user research experience. You have interviewed and observed real users and turned that into design decisions, not just collected feedback on finished work
  • Ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a clear, usable solution, and to balance user needs against business goals and technical constraints
  • Strong prototyping ability in Figma or equivalent
  • Information architecture and design-system thinking: you structure complex information so it is navigable, and you build reusable components rather than one-off screens
  • Comfort designing for expert users whose domain you do not know at the start, and the discipline to learn the domain rather than guess at it
  • Comfort working with subject-matter experts whose time is limited, and the ability to get what you need from a short session
  • Accessibility fluency: Section 508 and WCAG as normal practice
  • Comfortable working without an established design practice around you, and willing to help build one
  • Hands-on. You do the design work. This is not a design management role
  • Comfortable in a cross-functional agile product team
  • US Citizenship Required
  • Active US Top Secret clearance. Discovery and design work happens with users inside a controlled government environment and requires CAC eligibility from the start. This is a current-clearance requirement, not a sponsorship opportunity
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites, DEFCON AI HQ, and vendor facilities as required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for government users, including work inside controlled environments
  • Experience designing review-queue, triage, or high-volume workflow interfaces
  • Experience designing interfaces that present AI or model output, including explainability, confidence, and human review patterns
  • Experience with government accessibility review and remediation
  • Experience running design work on a fixed-deliverable schedule with formal customer acceptance
  • Front-end fluency (HTML, CSS, React) sufficient to work closely with engineers
  • Experience with enterprise, regulated, or technically complex products
  • Experience contributing to or evolving a design system

What Success Looks Like

  • Workflow maps and an interactive prototype accepted by the customer on schedule, early in the program
  • Users who recognize their own work in the design, because it came from watching them do it
  • An interface that holds up under a full workload, not only in a demo
  • Model output presented so users can tell when to trust it and when to push back
  • Work that ships with minimal rework
  • Design capacity that no longer depends on any one person

What We Offer:

  • A fully remote, results-based environment
  • Competitive salary, bonus, and equity package
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
  • Unlimited PTO, with your manager’s approval
  • Flexible work environment where you manage your work day
  • 14 weeks of fully-paid parental leave

Salary Range: $180,000-$215,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits:

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.
  • Unlimited PTO, with management approval.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available.
  • Mental health benefits are available through Tara Mind.
  • Cost effective GLP-1 solutions available through Crux.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

These providers include applicant tracking systems, candidate verification platforms, and fraud detection tools (collectively, "Hiring Platforms"). Your application materials, including your résumé, cover letter, work samples, responses to application questions, and any other information you submit, may be transmitted to and processed by these Hiring Platforms for the following purposes:

jobs.description:
Laravel is looking for our first dedicated Senior Infrastructure Engineer, PostgreSQL to join our all-remote Laravel Cloud infrastructure team. For this role we're only considering applications in the EU and Eastern US timezones.

We're on a mission to improve the experience of developers everywhere in the world. To do so, we don't only need to build beautiful software products, we also need to have a solid infrastructure foundation. We always look at products end-to-end when we build something new, and love to keep our users front and center regardless of which part of the product we're building, so we are not only looking for a person who knows how to work with cloud providers and infrastructure, but someone who is able to have empathy for our users and wants to build the best possible products possible.

Databases are the part of that foundation our users trust us with most - it's where their data lives, and it's the thing they can least afford to have go wrong. We're tackling some ambitious and exciting infrastructure projects, and we are looking for a colleague who can help us succeed with the mission - not just solve infrastructure problems. We are looking for someone who is pragmatic and a team player, someone who knows the best practices, but also knows when a custom solution is required.

For this role, we are specifically looking for someone to join the Infrastructure team, working on our Laravel Cloud platform. Laravel Cloud is a fully managed infrastructure platform built for developers and teams who just want to ship their next big idea, and it's relentlessly optimized for Laravel and PHP. Managed PostgreSQL is a core part of that platform, and we want someone to own it end to end: the operator that runs it, the automation around it, the reliability story, and the best practices we hold ourselves to.

This is a build-it-from-the-ground-up role. You will be the person who takes our PostgreSQL offering from "it works" to "it's excellent", and you'll have real latitude to decide what that means. Kubernetes, AWS, and Go are the tools you'll use to get there. If these things appeal to you, then please come join us on this exciting journey!

Infrastructure Engineering at Laravel

  • Work together with a world class team, touching the developer experience of hundreds of thousands of developers around the world.
  • Work on our most ambitious project yet, the recently announced Laravel Cloud platform.
  • Spend time researching the best solutions. We want to make sure we do the right things right.
  • Value the collaborative process, we often pair program or have quick huddles to tackle tricky problems and like to come up with solutions together.
  • Enjoy programming(!). Even though we're often working with cloud providers such as AWS, we also sometimes need to build custom tooling and integrations and we enjoy doing that ourselves.
  • Documentation is king, especially in an all-remote company. We pride ourselves in documenting for ourselves and for our users.
  • Flexible hours and minimum bureaucracy, allowing you the freedom to get your best work done whichever way you prefer.

What you'll be doing

  • Deploy, manage, and optimize PostgreSQL clusters on Kubernetes, owning high availability, performance, backups, and disaster recovery.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Kubernetes operators and controllers in Go to automate database and platform operations.
  • Design, build, and operate highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS across multiple accounts and regions.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and automate the operational workflows that are still manual today.
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and security through monitoring, observability, and proactive capacity planning.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues across PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve developer experience, CI/CD pipelines, and platform automation.
  • Define and promote best practices for database operations, and mentor engineers as our PostgreSQL expertise grows around you.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: You understand our PostgreSQL platform, the surrounding infrastructure, our workloads, and where the operational pain actually is.
  • First 60 days: You have taken ownership of PostgreSQL operations and started improving reliability, monitoring, and automation.
  • First 90 days: You have delivered measurable improvements in performance, scalability, and operational maturity, and you are setting the long-term direction for the platform.
  • After 12 months: You are the owner and the expert for PostgreSQL at Laravel. Operational complexity is lower, database practices are better, and engineering teams build and scale on top of PostgreSQL with confidence.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering, preferably working closely with large scale production systems.
  • Deep expertise with PostgreSQL in production: performance tuning, replication, backups and recovery, high availability, major version upgrades, and troubleshooting under pressure.
  • Mastery of AWS (or GCP), designing, deploying, and operating production cloud infrastructure.
  • Preferably, you have worked in large AWS environments, dealing with customer data in multi-account setups spread across multiple regions.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and container orchestration, including production cluster operations, stateful workloads, storage, networking, RBAC, cluster upgrades, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong proficiency in Go, with experience building and maintaining K8s operators and controllers using tools such as Kubebuilder, controller-runtime, and the Operator SDK.
  • Strong Linux systems administration and networking fundamentals - network protocols, load balancing, caching, and DNS management.
  • Experienced and comfortable with using IaC in a team (Terraform preferred), enforcing sanity checks and policies to help us scale.
  • Experience with CI/CD and GitOps workflows, using tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
  • Experienced and opinionated about logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling and processes (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Preferably, you have run PostgreSQL on Kubernetes with an operator such as CloudNativePG or Crunchy Postgres for Kubernetes.

Benefits

  • Fully remote and globally distributed working environment
  • Option to attend Laracon conferences around the world

  • Paid time off (Vacation, Sick & Public holidays)
  • Family leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Pension plans (As locally applicable)
  • Performance based bonus plan
  • Company equity

Position: Director of Major Gifts

Reports to: Vice President of Philanthropy

Department: Philanthropy

Location: U.S.Remote

Who we are:

CIEE is a non-profit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

Why work with us:

  • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
  • You will receive a competitive total rewards package (only applicable for U.S. employees).CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:
    • Paid time off and Parental leave
    • Gym Reimbursement Program
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Short-term & Long-term Disability
    • 6 floating Fridays (based on our eligibility rules)
    • CIEE Study Abroad Program discounts
    • 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer contribution
    • Insurance Coverage (life, travel, medical, dental, and vision)
    • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts (medical and dependent)
    • Voluntary Benefits (identity theft protection, pet insurance, accident, and critical illness)
  • You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals. CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study abroad locations, with facilities and staff in over 30 countries. Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year.  Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

Who you are:

You are an experienced, resilient, and curious fundraiser who is equally comfortable opening new relationships and advancing established ones. You understand that discovery requires persistence, sound judgment, and the ability to distinguish genuine opportunity from polite interest. You are motivated by results, but you also know that sustainable fundraising is built through trust, disciplined followthrough, and strong internal collaboration,

What you’ll do:

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of major and leadership gift donors and prospects, with an initial emphasis on discovery, qualification, and relationship development.
  • Conduct substantial proactive outreach to CIEE alumni and high-net-worth individuals who care about international education, including those with limited recent engagement with CIEE, and move promising relationships from initial contact to meaningful next steps and solicitation.
  • Prioritize and develop relationships with current donors who demonstrate potential for increased support, while also qualifying new prospects from CIEE's broader constituencies.
  • Develop and execute individualized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies that align donor interests with CIEE's established priorities and campaign goals.
  • Secure significant gifts and develop donors toward major-gift support, recognizing that a donor's first meaningful gift may be below CIEE's formal major-gift threshold.
  • Leverage the 80th anniversary and matching-gift opportunity to create timely, compelling pathways for engagement and giving while building relationships that extend beyond the campaign.
  • Prepare donor strategies, briefing materials, correspondence, proposals, and other materials tailored to donors' interests and decision-making needs.
  • Engage philanthropy leadership, executives, program leaders, alumni, board members, and other partners at the right moments in cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Use available wealth-screening, donor data, institutional knowledge, and research resources to identify, prioritize, and evaluate donor prospects.
  • Recommend strategic travel plans that maximize donor engagement and make responsible use of organizational resources.
  • Maintain timely and accurate donor records, contact reports, next steps, gift opportunities, and revenue forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Coordinate closely with annual giving and alumni engagement to support high[1]volume outreach, avoid conflicting communications, and transition responsive prospects into personalized relationship development.
  • Help establish and refine qualification, portfolio management, moves management, stewardship, travel, and donor-engagement practices in partnership with philanthropy leadership and operations.
  • Identify appropriate planned-giving, family foundation, donor-advised fund, corporate, or other opportunities that emerge through assigned relationships, coordinating with colleagues as needed.
  • Contribute to a collaborative fundraising culture in which relationship strategy and revenue credit reflect meaningful team contributions.

What you’ll bring:

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Seven to ten years of progressively responsible fundraising experience preferred, including substantial experience with individual giving.
  • Proven track record of cultivating, soliciting, and closing significant gifts, including five- and six-figure commitments.
  • Demonstrated success initiating and developing donor relationships through proactive outreach, including relationships that were not previously qualified or fully developed.
  • Experience building or substantially expanding a donor portfolio rather than only managing a mature, inherited caseload.
  • Strong judgment in donor qualification, strategy development, solicitation timing, and the use of organizational leaders and partners.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including comfort engaging high-net-worth individuals and navigating complex relationships.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-based environment where several colleagues may contribute materially to a donor relationship or gift.
  • Strong organizational skills, disciplined follow-through, and comfort working toward clear activity, pipeline, and revenue expectations.
  • Experience using fundraising CRM systems; Salesforce experience is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort using donor data, wealth-screening results, and qualitative information to prioritize outreach without treating capacity alone as qualification.
  • An entrepreneurial and practical approach to building systems, testing strategies, and improving results in an evolving program.
  • A genuine interest in international education, cultural exchange, and CIEE's mission. Prior CIEE involvement is valued but not required.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures and with people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.
  • Ability to embrace CIEE's Core Values: Excellence, Integrity, Respect, Inclusion, and Problem Solving.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

Due to federal regulations and CIEE policies, a background check, reference check, and education and employment verification will be conducted as conditions of employment.
