About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. We are seeking a candidate with a strong background in digital asset platform architecture to help clients with a wide range of existing and emerging use cases, including cross-border payments, tokenization, trading, settlement, custody, and compliance.

A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them primarily through virtual meetings, and also through on-site visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred

  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience

  • 3+ years of experience in payments, fintech, enterprise technology, or advisory roles with exposure to large enterprise or government clients.

  • Strong understanding of tokenization (data and asset), stablecoins, tokenized deposits, blockchain, and the digital asset regulatory landscape.

  • Familiarity with enterprise processes and architectures that need to integrate digital asset capabilities.

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Company:Driven Brands

The Automotive Training Institute (ATI), the largest coaching and training company for Owners of Independent Repair Shops in the US and Canada. With over 1700 shops actively engaged in our program, we provide coaching, training and the largest buying program in the automotive aftermarket for Independent Shop Owners. Our members have cumulatively increased their Gross Profits by almost $3.0 Billion dollars through the ATI program.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Instructor, Mechanical is a senior-level member of ATI's instructional team, delivering ATI's curriculum to independent mechanical and general repair shop owners and their teams while taking on a broadened scope of responsibility for content quality, classroom standards, and the development of other instructors.

The Senior Instructor combines deep, credible mechanical-industry expertise with advanced instructional skill, translating complex business and operational concepts into practical, immediately applicable knowledge. Beyond individual classroom performance, the Senior Instructor is expected to model and elevate instructional standards across the mechanical instruction team, mentor newer instructors, and serve as a trusted content authority within the mechanical curriculum.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Course Instruction (Mechanical)

  • Deliver ATI curriculum to independent mechanical and general repair shop owners and their teams across live, virtual, and on-demand formats.

  • Translate business concepts — financials, sales, leadership, succession, and operations — into practical, shop-floor applications for a mechanical/general repair audience.

  • Adapt delivery style and content to the format, audience, and experience level of each session, including advanced and owner-level cohorts.

  • Serve as lead or anchor instructor for flagship courses, multi-day events, and higher-stakes sessions as assigned.

Curriculum & Content Leadership

  • Partner closely with curriculum and instructional design staff to keep mechanical-relevant content accurate, current, and credible.

  • Provide subject-matter review and feedback on new or revised mechanical curriculum prior to broader rollout.

  • Identify content gaps and emerging mechanical-industry topics, and recommend new course or session development.

Content Research & Development

  • Dedicate regular, structured time to researching developments in the mechanical/general repair industry, including evolving technologies (EV service, ADAS, diagnostics, telematics), labor market shifts, parts supply dynamics, and changing shop economics.

  • Actively monitor industry publications, trade associations, OEM technical resources, and peer research to maintain current, credible subject-matter expertise across ATI's mechanical curriculum.

  • Review existing course materials on a defined cycle to assess continued relevance, accuracy, and alignment with the realities participants are facing in their shops today — recommending updates, retirements, or new content as warranted.

  • Synthesize industry research into actionable insights and translate those insights into curriculum recommendations, new session concepts, or in-course examples that reflect what is happening on the shop floor right now.

  • Collaborate with ATI's curriculum, instructional design, and market intelligence functions to ensure research findings move efficiently from discovery into updated course content.

  • Bring participant feedback from the classroom — questions asked, confusion surfaced, real-world situations raised — back into the content review process as a primary signal for curriculum improvement.

Instructor Mentorship & Team Development

  • Mentor and onboard newer or less experienced instructors, including classroom observation and constructive feedback.

  • Model exemplary classroom presence, facilitation of discussion, and member engagement for the broader instruction team.

  • Support the Department Leader in calibrating instructional quality standards across the mechanical instruction team.

Professional Development & Skills Building

  • Actively seek out and participate in skills-building opportunities — including ATI-provided training, industry conferences, instructional development programs, and peer learning — as an ongoing professional responsibility, not a periodic exception.

  • Engage fully with ATI's instructor development initiatives, including cohort debriefs, feedback sessions, and any formal development programming offered by ATI's Training & Development leadership.

  • Pursue continuous growth in instructional craft, facilitation technique, adult learning principles, and subject-matter depth. ATI is committed to supporting this development; candidates must be equally committed to pursuing it.

  • Model a genuine growth orientation for the broader instructor team — demonstrate that learning is an active, lifelong practice expected at every level of the organization.

General

  • Represent ATI professionally with members, partners, and at industry events.

  • Contribute mechanical-industry insight to the broader Training & Development team.

  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of ATI's mechanical-member experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial mechanical/general repair industry experience with a record of credibility among shop owners and operators.

  • Demonstrated, sustained track record instructing or presenting to groups in live and/or virtual settings, including more advanced or experienced audiences.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the judgment to guide discussion among experienced business owners.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, or develop other instructors or team members.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and to travel occasionally for live events and meetings.

  • Demonstrated personal commitment to ongoing professional growth and skills development. Candidates who are not actively invested in their own learning are not a fit for this role, regardless of experience level.

*Note: Prior mechanical shop ownership is welcomed but not required. Demonstrated industry expertise and instructional ability take precedence.*

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated knowledge across several of the following mechanical/general repair domains is strongly preferred:

  • Shop financials, KPIs, and performance management

  • Service advisor performance, sales process, and customer experience

  • Technician productivity, scheduling, and labor management

jobs.description:
Higher Logic exists to connect people, knowledge, and ideas to improve lives and organizations. Through our community solutions, we empower growth-stage businesses and associations to build a more engaged and meaningful relationship with their customers and members. Higher Logic serves more than 3,000 customers, representing over 350,000 online communities with greater than 200 million users in more than 42 countries worldwide.

We strive to understand the why behind our actions and bring our best selves to work every day.

Higher Logic is looking for a Content Marketing Manager to help us create useful, engaging content for two core audiences: associations and B2B companies.

Reporting to the Senior Content Marketing Manager, this person will contribute ideas to Higher Logic’s broader content strategy and independently manage content projects from concept through publication and promotion. The role is highly hands-on and includes writing and editing blog posts, ebooks, guides, webinar content, website copy, and organic social media content.

This person will also help manage Higher Logic’s social media presence. Social media experience is highly preferred, but this is not solely a social media position.

The right candidate will be an adaptable writer and thoughtful marketer who enjoys working across formats, helping brands tell compelling stories, and turning business priorities into clear, valuable content.

Higher Logic is a high-trust, collaborative organization. Some projects will begin with an established brief or campaign direction, while others will give this person the opportunity to recommend an approach and shape the work themselves.   • Create blog posts, ebooks, guides, webinar content, website copy, organic social content, and occasional email or campaign copy.

  • Create social media carousels, short-form videos, and other visual content using established design templates.

  • Adapt messaging for different audiences, formats, and channels while maintaining a consistent Higher Logic brand voice.
  • Apply SEO and digital discoverability best practices to content planning and production.

  • Conduct all business in accordance with Higher Logic values, policies, and procedures.

Knowledge and Abilities Required

  • At least three years of relevant experience in content marketing, editorial, communications, or a related field.
  • Experience writing and editing both long-form and short-form content for multiple formats.
  • Working knowledge of SEO principles and their application to content creation.
  • Comfort using AI-powered tools and documented workflows to accelerate content development, streamline repeatable tasks, and improve team efficiency, while maintaining strong editorial judgment and quality control.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to turn complex or loosely defined topics into accessible, audience-focused content.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • The initiative and judgment to move work forward independently while knowing when to seek input or collaboration.
  • Comfort using performance data to evaluate content and inform future work.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, marketers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing organic social media channels for a brand or organization.

  • Familiarity with B2B SaaS, associations, membership organizations, online communities, or marketing technology.
  • Familiarity with tools such as WordPress, Semrush, GA4, HubSpot, Salesforce, Hootsuite, Canva, ChatGPT, or Riverside.

What You Can Expect

  • A remote working environment, with access to Higher Logic’s Arlington-area headquarters for employees located near Washington, D.C.
  • A collaborative marketing team that values thoughtful ideas, open feedback, and strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Meaningful ownership of projects and the autonomy to determine how your work takes shape.

You’ll earn:

  • Comprehensive health benefits package.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Healthcare and dependent-care flexible spending account.
  • Company short-term and long-term disability insurance.
  • Company culture that recognizes its employees.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance

A bit about this role:

As Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance, you are the tactical owner of every clinical pharmacy-related measure in our Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings portfolio. Your job is to drive our clinical pharmacy Stars enterprise strategy into daily reality, measure by measure, member by member, week by week. This is the most consequential set of measures we own.

You will be the enterprise clinical subject matter expert on pharmacy quality: the person Medical Directors call before they call anyone else, the person who reads the Technical Notes the day they drop, and the person who can tell us in February where a cut point is going to land in October and what we need to do about it now. You will also be the person building the tracker, setting the objectives and key results, and personally auditing whether the outreach was actually effective.

You will report directly to the AVP, Pharmacy, carrying the portfolio into executive meetings, leading cross-functional escalations, and owning outcomes.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Performance Management & Insight Generation. Own the performance trajectory of the full clinical pharmacy Star portfolio, including the triple-weighted medication adherence measures (Diabetes, RAS Antagonists, Statins), Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes (SUPD), Polypharmacy: Use of Multiple Anticholinergic Medications in Older Adults (Poly-ACH), and Concurrent Use of Opioids and Benzodiazepines (COB). Forecast measure trajectories against projected cut points, identify risk months before it shows up in a year-end score, and translate the analysis into daily, weekly, and monthly operating directives that internal teams and vendors can actually execute against.

  • Clinical Subject Matter Expertise & Clinical Collaboration. Serve as the authoritative clinical voice on pharmacy quality. Track regulatory specification changes and clinical guideline shifts and interpret what they mean for our operations. Lead peer-to-peer dialogue with clinical leaders within Devoted and our growing provider network.

  • Future Measure Readiness. Keep us ahead of the measure set rather than reacting to it. Track what CMS is developing, what sits on the display page, and what the measure developer pipeline is producing. Build the data and operational capability for a measure while it's still on display, so that when it enters Stars we are already performing instead of standing up a workflow. Own the read on every Advance Notice, Proposed Rule, and Final Rule, translate them into what specifically changes for Devoted, and bring us a point of view.

  • Strategy & Innovation. Design organization-wide strategies across the portfolio of clinical pharmacy measures to deliver 5-Star performance at scale. You will identify innovative opportunities to eliminate friction points along members’ healthcare journeys, empowering them to achieve their healthiest lives.

  • Excellent Cross-Functional Execution. Manage performance against operating KPIs and clinical outcomes metrics by partnering with internal Devoted teams and external partners, including our PBM, to design and implement solutions that improve clinical and care coordination interventions. You will translate goals into actionable strategies and guide initiatives from pilot phase through full-scale implementation across our member population as well as our provider and pharmacy networks.

  • Market Awareness. Keep a pulse on the vendor landscape: who is doing credible work in adherence stratification, pharmacist-led intervention, and pharmacy network engagement, what those platforms actually deliver versus what the sales deck promises, and whether there's a case for bringing one in. We build rather than buy by default. We expect you to have an informed opinion on when that calculus should change, and to be able to defend it either way.

  • Servant Leadership. Drive execution through a blend of direct management and leadership through influence, operating with a true servant-leader mindset that prioritizes enabling, unblocking, and supporting teams. You will translate complex operational goals into daily workflows that set our teams - and our members - up for success.

Required skills and experience:

  • PharmD or equivalent clinical degree. The role demands clinical credibility and independent clinical judgment on complex medication management strategies.

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership in managed care, a health plan, or a PBM, with dedicated ownership of Medicare Advantage and Part D quality programs and a documented, quantifiable track record of moving clinical pharmacy Stars measures in a volatile cut point environment.

  • Execution instinct. You are a relentless self-starter who refuses to let initiatives die in committee. You will roll up your sleeves to manipulate raw data, draft a workflow, or personally audit a vendor's call dispositions. You measure yourself on what shipped, not what was discussed. You thrive in environments where you need to move fast and adapt quickly.

  • Insight generation. Advanced analytical acumen and the ability to see past the surface of a dashboard to the root cause of non-adherence, then design the targeted, cost-effective intervention that addresses it. Comfort with business intelligence tooling and with sizing an opportunity before committing resources to it.

  • Demonstrated leadership impact and collaborative excellence, with experience successfully influencing outcomes across organizational levels, whether through direct management, cross-functional project leadership, or matrix reporting relationships that require building consensus without formal authority. You are energized by working with diverse backgrounds, and deeply motivated by helping our front line teams do their best work and members achieve their best, healthiest lives.

  • Clinical diplomacy. You can hold a nuanced clinical conversation with a skeptical clinical leader, earn their respect, and change prescribing behavior without authority over them.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Motivated by learning quickly in complex clinical and operational domains. You read the source material yourself and are excited to catch everyone up.

  • AI explorations. Curiosity about emerging technologies and a pragmatic approach to using them. Experience using LLMs to build complex prompts and tools is a strong plus.

  • Skill and rigor in using and analyzing data. You understand the pitfalls of metrics (e.g., how open vs. closed periods affect data, or how denominators shift over time). You are comfortable thinking in ranges and probabilities rather than false precision, and you can distinguish between a metric changing and the underlying reality changing.

Salary Range: $182,000 - $247,000 a year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

jobs.description:
About Routeware, Inc.

Routeware is the industry leader in providing software and data analysis that enables public and private enterprises to improve the effectiveness of their waste and recycling programs. Our solutions help organizations save time and money, increase efficiency, improve safety and help make our world a greener place.

Based in Portland, Oregon, the company employs a distributed team across North America and the UK. Our brands, products, and services provide an all-in-one platform to municipal and private waste haulers and other fleet services. As part of an essential and growing industry, we seek solution-oriented team players who want to positively impact the environment. Our work environment is collaborative, dynamic, fast-paced, and fun with a strong appreciation for innovation and initiative.

Our Mission:

  • Transform waste collection to drive a better future for generations to come.

Our Values:

  • Adaptability - The waste industry and technology are ever-changing, and the Routeware team never stops adapting to be at the forefront of technology innovation, supporting our customers to stay ahead.
  • Mission-driven - At Routeware, it matters to us that our work has a lasting positive impact on our customers' outcomes, our fellow team members' well-being, and the long-term sustainability of our environment.
  • Human-first - While technology drives our products; the real, live, caring people at Routeware are the true drivers of meaningful outcomes for our customers.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Routeware’s Business Operations product line manages the all-in-one connected front and back office for private haulers. Our customer is a municipal program manager; our user is a resident who just wants to know if Tuesday is a holiday and whether pizza boxes go in recycling.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to help drive day-to-day execution on this product line. You’ll partner closely with the VP of Product, taking on roadmap delivery, story writing, sprint execution, and validation work. Over time, as we unify teams and integrate further with the rest of the Routeware platform, your scope and ownership will grow. You’ll also work with a distributed engineering team that includes offshore developers, which means written clarity, detailed acceptance criteria, and async-friendly working habits matter.

This is a meaningful seat for a PM with a few years under their belt who wants to ship product in a B2B SaaS environment with a real societal impact. It’s also a great place to apply AI to a real-world problem, both exploring opportunities and helping ship production features that drive adoption.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Roadmap Execution & Delivery: Partner closely with the VP of Product to execute the product line roadmap. Own daily execution: discovery, story writing, sprint planning, acceptance criteria, and validation. Ship clean, on time, and with quality.
  • Cross-Product Collaboration: Contribute to integration work between Business Operations and the broader Routeware platform. Partner with PMs on adjacent product lines as we work toward a more unified portfolio.
  • Distributed Delivery & Engineering Partnership: Work effectively with a distributed engineering team that includes offshore developers. Write specs that don’t require a hallway conversation to interpret. Run sprint ceremonies in an async-friendly way.
  • AI Feature Delivery: Help identify, scope, and ship AI-powered capabilities in the resident journey — smarter search, conversational sorting guidance, personalized education, contamination reduction.
  • Launch & Adoption: Partner with Marketing, CS, and Support on go-to-market — release readiness, internal enablement, customer comms, and adoption tracking after launch.
  • Voice of Customer & Measurement: Stay close to Support and Customer Success — triage escalations, feed real-world signal back into the roadmap, and track KPIs for your scope (adoption, engagement, education effectiveness).

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Background shipping B2B products. You understand engagement, retention, and how to design for a non-expert end user.
  • 2–3+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership in SaaS, with progressive scope and ownership.
  • Strong agile fluency: backlog management, story writing, sprint planning, prioritization frameworks.
  • Experience working with distributed or offshore engineering teams — or strong evidence of the written clarity and async habits that make it work.
  • Strong analytical instincts — comfortable with product analytics, experimentation, and metrics-driven prioritization.
  • Familiarity with AI / LLM-powered product capabilities and the judgment to know where they add real value vs. where they’re overkill.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate between customers, internal teams, and executives.
  • Hands-on fluency with Jira, Confluence, and a product analytics tool (Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, similar).

Bonus

  • Background in civic tech, waste/recycling, utilities, or other municipal-adjacent SaaS.
  • Experience with behavior-change product design or educational/content-heavy product surfaces.
  • Track record contributing to product integration or unification work across multiple product lines.
  • Experience shipping AI features into a consumer-facing product.
  • Familiarity with localization, accessibility, and multi-tenant product configurability.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who combines strong Playwright and TypeScript engineering skills with a proactive, collaborative mindset. You'll be a key contributor to how we deliver quality, raising the bar for our automation codebase and partnering closely with engineering to define how testing responsibility is shared across the team.

You’ll join our dynamic and growing Product Engineering team at Storyblok, playing an instrumental role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our flagship CMS platform. This platform empowers businesses to create and deliver seamless digital content experiences.

In this role, you'll work closely with product owners, designers, and developers to design and maintain clean, scalable, well-architected TypeScript automation, establish clear guidelines on which test level is right for a given change, and continuously refine QA strategies to maintain best-in-class software quality. About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to client code and backend services. The client code is a mix of C#, XAML, and Go. Prior Go expertise is not a requirement.
  • Bring a special focus on our Windows platform, building and maintaining our Windows client using the modern WinUI/Windows App SDK stack, while contributing to common code that supports macOS, mobile, and other core client platforms.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with engineers on a native Windows desktop client using Windows App SDK, WinUI, C#, XAML and Go
  • Implement support for the latest Windows platform features while maintaining compatibility with a subset of older versions
  • Develop and optimize product features on Windows, with a focus on UI components and platform integration
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests using Microsoft Testing Platform v2 and xUnit
  • Contribute to common, cross-platform Tailscale code

  • Four or more years of experience in software development
  • Strong understanding of software development principles, capabilities, and limitations of the Windows platform
  • Proficiency in C# and modern native UI frameworks (WinUI/UWP/WPF)

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber is building one of the most technically advanced fiber-first broadband networks in the Pacific Northwest, and we're moving fast. As Vice President of Network Architecture & Engineering, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full network stack — access, voice, subscriber edge, IP core, transport, and infrastructure. You will lead a team of Principal Architects and Directors, own the multi-year technology roadmap, and drive the transformation programs that reduce cost, accelerate deployment, and position Ziply for competitive leadership in every market we enter.

This is an executive role that demands equal command of technical depth and business impact. You will build the business cases, secure the investments, and deliver the results — measured in dollars saved, deployment velocity accelerated, and operational dependencies eliminated.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Network Architecture Strategy & Transformation

·Define and own the multi-year network architecture roadmap across voice, access, subscriber edge, IP core & metro, transport, and infrastructure domains.

·Drive technology transformation programs: legacy platform exits, vendor-agnostic architecture adoption, zero-touch provisioning, and network automation.

Leadership & Organizational Capability

·Lead and scale a team of Principal Architects and Directors; build organizational capability through director- and principal-level hiring and development.

·Represent the technology organization in executive-level discussions, board briefings, and strategic partnership negotiations.

·Set clear objectives, success metrics, and accountability for architecture and engineering leaders; coach teams through complex technical, financial, and organizational tradeoffs.

·Develop succession depth and leadership bench strength for critical architecture and engineering functions.

Business Case, Investment & Financial Planning

·Develop and own business cases for major network investments — quantifying cost savings, stranded asset recovery, and competitive positioning for executive and board approval.

·Deliver measurable cost reductions through optics standardization, technology consolidation (DACS, legacy platforms), and operational independence from TSA and vendor lock-in agreements.

·Collaborate with the Enterprise Delivery Office on CapEx and OpEx planning for all network engineering initiatives.

Technology Certification, Vendor Strategy & Selection

·Establish and operate a technology certification program: device qualification, PoC lab management, vendor-donated equipment programs, and accelerated certification cycles.

·Own vendor and technology selection: RFPs, PoCs, architecture reviews, and contract negotiations across the network stack.

Cross-Functional Operations & Execution

·Partner with Network Planning, Platform Ops, IT/Platform Technology, and NOC to ensure architecture enables operational efficiency and autonomous network operations.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

·15+ years of progressive network engineering and architecture experience, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a broadband ISP, CLEC, or telco.

·Proven track record of delivering large-scale network transformation programs with quantifiable business impact — cost savings, asset recovery, or competitive differentiation measured in the tens to hundreds of millions.

·Experience scaling high-performance architecture or engineering teams; demonstrated ability to add director- and principal-level talent to strengthen organizational capability.

·Hands-on experience with transport (400G/100G), fiber voice/VoIP business cases, and CPE/modem platform migrations at scale.

·Deep familiarity with zero-touch provisioning, vendor-agnostic orchestration, and network automation platforms.

·Experience exiting legacy technology dependencies: TSA agreements, end-of-life platforms (DACS, TDM, legacy ACS), and third-party operational agreements.

·Strong business acumen: ability to build, defend, and deliver on multi-million-dollar investment cases at the executive level.

·Excellent cross-functional leadership: able to align engineering, operations, finance, and vendor partners around shared outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

·Advanced degree such as MS, MBA, or equivalent executive-level business or technical education.

·Experience establishing or operating a technology lab or architecture center (vendor certification, PoC environments, donated equipment programs).

·Background in digital transformation or operations modernization — omni-channel, automation, AI-assisted operations, or field technician tooling.

·Intellectual property, publication, patent, or industry thought-leadership experience in networking, automation, platform modernization, or subscriber experience domains.

·Prior experience at a fiber-first or fiber-overbuilder ISP in a competitive broadband market.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Executive presence with the ability to influence across Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, and executive leadership.

·Strong analytical, financial, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance technical excellence, customer impact, operational risk, and business value.

·Ability to build trust, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

At all times, Ziply Fiber must be your primary employer. Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

Diverse Workforce / EEO:

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, and the presence of a non-job-related handicap or disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.excerpt: United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country.
jobs.description:
United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to support, engage, and empower them to make their voice heard and win!

With an online reach of over 2 million, more than 500,000 members as well as over 100 local groups, UWD is made up of fearless youth fighting to improve the lives of our members and their families. Our vision is a society which celebrates our diversity and believes in a multi-ethnic, intersectional path to getting there.

Whether we’re organizing in the streets, providing immigration services, building innovative technology systems, opening doors for LGBTQ immigrant youth, clearing pathways to education, stopping deportations or creating alliances across social movements, United We Dream puts undocumented immigrant youth in the driver’s seat. UWD is a fast paced, dynamic

organization which has become a leading voice in social change and has appeared in every major news outlet in the country.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Our grassroots-driven approach has a proven record of success and we’re looking for talented folks to join our team!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Leading the Dream Campaign Fellowship is a fellowship program for college students (sophomores, juniors, and seniors) who are passionate about social justice and energized to advocate for change in their communities. The program will provide fellows with training, coaching, and hands-on experience to grow their skills as organizers and leaders. Fellows will also have the opportunity to become part of a community of like-minded youth advocates and to become a part of the United We Dream Network. Fellows will be expected to fully engage with the training curriculum to build up their campaign and advocacy skills and to complete a set of assignments putting those skills into action. This is a remote, part-time position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in weekly workshops throughout the 10 weeks of the program to grow your critical thinking skills, develop key campaign and organizing skills, and deepen your understanding of social justice advocacy and transformation.
  • Build relationships with UWD members, student organizations and local interest groups, forging strategic partnerships to amplify the visibility of member campaigns and mobilize collective action.
  • Participate in recurring trainings, meetings, check-ins, and one-on-ones with UWD staff, members, and partners to build and strengthen relationships, complete assignments as needed, and put your campaign skills into practice.
  • Create trainings, presentations, method guides, reports, and other written materials as needed to train and build up the organizing capacity of diverse audiences, such as UWD members, staff, partner groups, and others.
  • Provide coaching to UWD member-students and support them through identifying issue-based campaigns, the decision-makers that can address their problems, potential allies to recruit, and a set of tactics to push forward their demands.
  • Complete assignments aimed at broadening your understanding of culture, politics and power, and exercises to place your campaign skills into practice in the real world.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Deeply committed to United We Dream’s mission and an ability to balance your burning passion for justice with a good sense of humor
  • Experience with writing and briefing reports
  • Excellent communication skills (written, oral, and interpersonal skills)
  • Enjoys working with others and is a team player with the ability to integrate data and insights from, individuals and teams across various departments
  • Ability to analyze and draw insights from data to synthesize and present the most important insights to senior-level and non-data people in an easy-to-understand way
  • Impeccable attention to detail; able to spot mistakes and inconsistencies missed by others
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and/or Google G-Suite applications, especially for analysis and presentation of data

CULTURAL COMPETENCY (MUST HAVES)

  • Strong understanding of the immigrant experience
  • Understanding of race, gender, sexuality and other aspects of identity, and their intersections, and how that plays out in the work
  • Demonstrates self-awareness of their own multiple group identities and their attendant dynamics, and can adapt approach as needed
  • Ability to build strong relationships and trust across race, gender, class, and other group identities, both internally and externally

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Compensation: Commensurate with experience. United We Dream offers a competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits package including paid vacation, health insurance, retirement plans, and life insurance.

Base pay ranges $25.00 per hour with a max of 15 hours per week.

Location: As UWD is a remote-first workplace, this is a part-time position. We have a preference to hire in states where we already have employees working from home - AZ, DC, CT, CA, FL, IL, MO, NJ, NM, NY, OK, SC, and TX. Once UWD determines it is safe to do so, you may be required to travel occasionally to DC or elsewhere, for internal team meetings, retreats, and UWD events as required for your role.

TO APPLY

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Edit: Please submit a resume, cover letter, through our career website . Please do not send duplicate materials and incomplete applications will not be considered. No phone calls, please.

###

UWD is an equal opportunity employer; people of color and individuals from diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply. UWD does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

The Head of E&S Property Underwriting is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategy, profitability, and day-to-day management of Skyward's E&S Brokerage Primary & Excess Property book. You will lead a team of 10 underwriters, reporting directly to the President of E&S Property & Casualty and Inland Marine. This is a player-coach role — you will set the underwriting vision and drive profitable growth while remaining hands-on with complex accounts, pricing discipline, and broker relationships.

Underwriting Leadership & Strategy

  • Own the underwriting direction, risk appetite, and portfolio composition of the E&S Property (Primary & Excess) book across all target classes, including manufacturers, industrial, vacant, hospitality, healthcare, mercantile, and real estate schedules

  • Set and enforce underwriting standards, pricing guidelines, and coverage parameters consistent with the book's profitability objectives

  • Lead complex and large-account underwriting decisions; serve as the technical authority and escalation point for the team

  • Maintain a disciplined approach to accumulation management, ensuring adherence to CAT exclusions (no Tier 1 Wind, Flood, or EQ/EQSL)

  • Drive use of underwriting indications to enable broker partners to set accurate client expectations and accelerate decisioning

Portfolio Management & Profitability

  • Monitor and actively manage loss ratios, combined ratios, and portfolio trends; take corrective action when segments underperform

  • Partner with actuarial and finance on pricing adequacy, rate monitoring, and reserving inputs

  • Analyze submission flow, hit ratios, and renewal retention to identify where the book is growing well and where it needs tightening

  • Balance profitable growth with underwriting discipline — new premium is only valuable if it performs

Team Management & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 property underwriters across experience levels

  • Establish clear performance expectations, accountability frameworks, and a culture of continuous improvement

  • Recruit and retain underwriting talent; build bench strength for future growth

  • Foster a team environment that rewards technical rigor, sound judgment, and broker responsiveness

Wholesale Distribution

  • Cultivate and deepen relationships with key wholesale broker partners; serve as a senior point of contact for strategic accounts

  • Collaborate with production and distribution leadership to identify appetite gaps and market opportunities

  • Represent Skyward at industry events, broker meetings, and wholesale market forums

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with claims, actuarial, legal, and product teams to ensure the book is supported end-to-end

  • Provide market and competitive intelligence to inform product development and pricing strategy

  • Partner with technology and operations to improve submission handling, data quality, and underwriting workflow efficiency

Experience

  • 10+ years of E&S or specialty property underwriting experience, with meaningful time in a wholesale/non-admitted environment

  • Prior leadership experience managing underwriting teams; comfort operating as both a strategic leader and technical contributor

  • Demonstrated track record of building or managing a profitable property book across a broad range of commercial classes

Technical Skills

  • Deep knowledge of commercial property underwriting, including COPE analysis, rate-on-line assessment, and coverage structure

  • Familiarity with layered property structures (ground-up, primary, quota share, and excess)

  • Working knowledge of ISO and proprietary property forms

  • Proficiency in evaluating equipment breakdown, property enhancement, and schedule risks

  • Strong understanding of CAT modeling concepts and accumulation management principles

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder — credible with both wholesale brokers and internal executive stakeholders

  • Data-driven decision-maker with the ability to translate portfolio analytics into actionable strategy

  • High accountability orientation; comfortable owning results and making hard calls on underperforming segments

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, with the ability to develop talent and build a high-performance culture

Compensation & Benefits

The applicable base salary for this opportunity is $235,000 - $270,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to the base salary, this opportunity may be eligible for performance-based incentives.​ We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition and professional certification assistance, 401k savings, elective participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid time off, paid holidays, and child bonding leave, as well as other employee assistance.

jobs.description:
Video Editor (Adobe Premiere, Social Media & Marketing Content) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility for launches, campaigns, and deadlines

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring a Video Editor for one of our clients to create engaging, polished, and performance-driven video content across social media, marketing campaigns, paid advertising, websites, and internal communications.

This is more than a technical editing role. You’ll be responsible for turning raw footage into compelling stories designed to capture attention, increase watch time, improve audience retention, and strengthen campaign performance.

You’ll create and optimize content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, and paid advertising channels.

If you understand how editing pace, storytelling, hooks, visuals, and platform-specific formats influence content performance, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging, and professional videos.
  • Create both short-form and long-form content.
  • Work with editing platforms such as:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Build edits around strong storytelling, pacing, and audience attention.
  • Create compelling openings and maintain viewer interest throughout each video.
  • Align every edit with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and marketing goals.
  • Adapt editing styles based on platform, audience, and content purpose.

Social Media & Platform Optimization

  • Create platform-native video content for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
    • LinkedIn
    • Websites
    • Paid advertising campaigns
  • Adapt content into multiple aspect ratios, including:
    • 16:9
    • 9:16
    • 1:1
  • Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content without making each version feel repetitive.
  • Optimize exports for the appropriate combination of quality, file size, and platform requirements.
  • Understand how editing styles differ between short-form social content, long-form video, and advertising creative.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancements

  • Add professional:
    • Captions
    • Titles
    • Lower thirds
    • Motion graphics
    • Transitions
    • Visual overlays
  • Use tools such as Adobe After Effects and Canva when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent typography, visual language, and brand presentation.
  • Enhance videos without over-editing or distracting from the core message.

Audio & Color

  • Clean and balance audio for professional output.
  • Improve dialogue clarity and reduce unwanted background noise.
  • Handle audio syncing and volume leveling.
  • Add appropriate licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and grading.
  • Maintain visual consistency between different cameras, clips, and environments.

Footage & Project Management

  • Import, organize, and maintain raw footage and creative assets.
  • Keep project files and folder structures clean and consistent.
  • Maintain clear version control throughout revision cycles.
  • Archive completed projects so footage and assets can be easily retrieved and repurposed.
  • Manage multiple editing projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Collaboration & Revisions

  • Work closely with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Content strategists
    • Creative teams
  • Receive and manage feedback through tools such as Frame.io and shared review systems.
  • Turn revisions around quickly while maintaining quality.
  • Communicate clearly about timelines, creative requirements, and deliverables.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback without losing consistency or creative direction.

Performance Optimization

  • Review content performance metrics including:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • Engagement
    • CTR
  • Identify patterns in high- and low-performing content.
  • Apply performance insights to future edits.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to test new hooks, formats, pacing, and creative approaches.
  • Continuously improve editing decisions based on actual audience behavior.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that great video editing is about storytelling and attention, not just transitions and effects.
  • You know how to make the opening seconds of a video count.
  • You can edit both short-form and long-form content effectively.
  • You understand how content consumption differs across TikTok, Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, and paid ads.
  • You can execute quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects.
  • You take ownership of your work from raw footage through final export.
  • You’re receptive to feedback and can handle revision cycles professionally.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency with one or more of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience editing social media and marketing content.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Video pacing
    • Storytelling
    • Viewer retention
    • Platform-specific content
  • Experience with:
    • Audio cleanup and syncing
    • Color correction
    • Captions and graphics
    • Multi-platform formatting
    • Platform-specific exports
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating professional video editing work.

Preferred Experience

  • Adobe After Effects and motion graphics experience.
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertising creatives
    • UGC-style videos
    • Performance marketing content
    • Short-form social content
    • Long-form YouTube content
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • CTR
    • Engagement
  • Experience using Frame.io or similar creative review platforms.
  • Background supporting:
    • SaaS companies
    • E-commerce brands
    • Marketing agencies
    • Media companies

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Video Editor’s day revolves around turning raw footage into content people actually want to watch. You will:

  • Review and organize incoming footage and creative briefs.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos.
  • Create social media and marketing campaign content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, and sound design.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color correction.
  • Create platform-specific versions and exports.
  • Review feedback and complete revisions.
  • Analyze content performance to improve future edits.
  • Archive completed projects and maintain organized creative files.

In short: you transform raw footage into polished, platform-native video content that captures attention, tells a compelling story, and drives measurable engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects.
  • Strong audience watch time and retention.
  • Improved engagement across video content.
  • Consistent brand quality across platforms.
  • Reduced and efficient revision cycles.
  • Accurate platform-specific formatting and delivery.
  • Organized, scalable project and asset management.
  • Positive feedback from marketing and creative stakeholders.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over creative output.
  • Direct impact on marketing and content performance.
  • Opportunity to create content across multiple platforms and formats.
  • Exposure to organic social, paid advertising, and brand content.
  • Performance-driven environment where creative decisions can be measured.
  • Fully remote collaboration with U.S.-based teams.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Video Editor
    • Creative Lead
    • Senior Content Producer
    • Content Director

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review + Practical Editing Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Love video editing and visual storytelling
  • Understand Adobe Premiere Pro and modern editing workflows
  • Know what makes social media content engaging
  • Can edit for both short-form and long-form formats
  • Understand pacing, hooks, watch time, and audience retention
  • Thrive in a fast-moving creative environment

We’d love to see your work.

Apply today with your portfolio or video editing reel and help create content that captures attention, strengthens brands, and drives performance.

jobs.description:
Executive Partner, Business Services – Chief Audit Executive (CAE)

About this role:

What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you? When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the world’s leading research and advisory company, achieving consistent double-digit growth by steering clients toward the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Here you’ll enjoy a collaborative work environment supporting some of the best organizations in the world. If you like working with a curious, supportive, high-performing team, then Gartner is the place for you.

When you join the Gartner Executive Partner for Chief Audit Executive team, you will experience a high-performance work environment within a company that knows no limits. Gartner Executive Partners serve as trusted advisors to our clients, who are Chief Audit Executives from organizations across all industries. This is a brand new product and a very exciting time to join the organization.

About this role: Our clients, Chief Audit Executives or the senior-most individuals responsible for Internal Audit, find themselves challenged with the pace of change impacting the Audit function and their respective organizations as companies continue to adapt and shift their business models to move faster and grow their companies in a rapidly evolving risk environment. With the support of their Executive Partner, our Gartner for CAE clients more adeptly align their audit priorities to the organization’s most critical objectives and deliver the assurance needed to help the organization more confidently achieve its objectives and manage risks. As an Executive Partner, you will have the opportunity to deliver solutions for the most critical audit and oversight challenges facing companies across all industries.

Partnering with our clients means that no two days are the same; you could be supporting the development of the overall audit department strategy and long-term vision, providing recommendations on assessing audit department productivity and capacity and creating performance metrics and budgets, advising on the audit function’s effective use of technology (including AI), or helping the CAE increase audit’s impact on the business. Clients will also look to you for advice and support on working more closely with the Audit Committee and the broader Board, CEO, and the rest of the management team on critical business goals and risks, communicating the value of the audit function, and establishing effective governance and oversight processes. You will support clients as they work to provide assurance over emerging risks to the company and support the Audit Committee in performing their oversight role. Gartner for CAE EPs serve as accountability partners through delivery of Gartner research insights and personal experiences/expertise on key initiatives, priorities, and strategies of their CAE clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide executive advisory services to CAE members who work across all industries and business models.
  • Synthesize Gartner insights and data to deliver world class advisory support through ongoing bi-weekly client engagement and periodic client working sessions. The ability and willingness to operate independently to adapt materials fit for client use is required.
  • Host, facilitate, and/or participate in periodic client activities, including working sessions to develop strategy, peer roundtables, sessions and client meetings at the annual conference and virtual webinars. These activities may be delivered virtually or on-site depending on circumstance.
  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing client needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Executive Program strategy and product deliverables.
  • Facilitate member interaction and peer collaboration through the Gartner for Audit member community portal and assisted member connections.
  • Work as a collaborative Gartner team member serving clients in conjunction with Client Support Professionals and Account Executives.
  • Participate in all phases of the client lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review, and renewal.
  • While you will not be responsible for creating content, you will be partnering with Business and Technology Insights (BTI) Analysts to help identify potential gaps in material that is relevant and valuable to our clients.
  • There will be a considerable focus on sales enablement in this role. You are responsible for client retention and for contributing to account growth through direct support of Gartner Sales Associates:
  • Working with the sales teams to help them understand the true value of the Guided Product to the client vs the Self-Directed product.
  • Building their confidence and ability to effectively engage with and sell to this level of C-suite prospect.
  • Through the creation of Value Stories, enable the sales associates to bring the service to life.
  • You will be partnering with sales on account planning / development activities as well as being present in proof-of-concept (POC) engagements with prospective clients.

What You’ll Need

  • The Executive Partner will be an accomplished Chief Audit Executive, working with the C-suite, the Audit Committee and Board of Directors and a host of stakeholders, with a broad base of expertise who has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • Deep experience working as a CAE (or the highest audit role within an organization) and at least 15+ years of experience in areas critical to leading an audit function.
  • An in-depth understanding of the Audit function and other adjacent functions, e.g., Compliance, Legal & Risk.
  • Ideally with a background across multiple industries to be able to support a wide variety of member organizations.
  • Audit or Consulting Firm experience, including client relationship management, is also highly beneficial.
  • Technologically savvy; our model is lean, and you’ll leverage AI and other tools to work quickly, including completing administrative tasks.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office suite of tools to adapt Power Points, leverage Excel Spreadsheets, and to use Word to draft client-ready materials.
  • Consulting background a plus.
  • Financial Services and Banking industry experience is a plus

Who You Are

  • Critical thinker and problem solver, demonstrating the ability to assess our clients’ situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business/technical advice as well as the ability to leverage appropriate Gartner resources to help clients achieve results.
  • Ability to build strategic internal partnerships with key roles across the organization and positively impact change
  • This role is a client-facing position that requires a high level of executive presence and ability to quickly build trust and deliver value.
  • Demonstrate superior verbal and written communication skills as well as strong facilitation and presentation and facilitation skills. Excellent communication and relationship management skills
  • Willing to work independently and handle administrative tasks.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT CAN BE LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE MAINLAND UNITED STATES.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

Consumers across the globe need safe, transparent financing while merchants want to provide users with their preferred way to pay and convert more buyers. To help achieve this vision, we are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our 1:Many Growth team.

Affirm's Distribution Partnerships program - internally called "1:Many" - is one of the highest-leverage growth levers at the company. Instead of integrating merchant by merchant, we integrate once into a platform merchants already use, and every merchant on that platform becomes reachable through that single integration. This role is responsible for:

  • Own and grow Affirm's partner portfolio - making it easier and more frictionless for merchants to onboard and offer Affirm as a payment method to their customers. This includes taking product ownership of Affirm's existing vertical software partnerships, and growing the broader portfolio of platform partners still being stood up.

  • Partner Acceleration Strategy - building the durable capabilities that make every future partner integration faster to launch and easier to scale, rather than solving the same problem one partner at a time.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams including commercial, merchant risk, design, product analytics, and engineering to define, launch and grow integrations with platform partners. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be outcomes-driven with a very high bias for action.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, launch, and grow integrations with payment and platform partners.
  • Build durable, repeatable capabilities through a Partner Acceleration Strategy that makes future partner integrations faster to launch.
  • Build relationships with platform partners to gather feedback and insights on product performance, and use it to drive merchant growth.
  • Define and prioritize product features and requirements to improve the customer, partner, and merchant experience.
  • Create and manage the product roadmap for the broader 1:Many growth team.
  • Develop success metrics/OKRs to measure the effectiveness of these initiatives.
  • Partner with commercial and product marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies for new partner integrations and features.

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • Proven ability to multiple technical software products from kickoff to post-launch, driving meaningful business impact you can clearly articulate.
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration — diving into technical details with engineers, iterating with designers in Figma, and analyzing funnel performance with data analysts.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills to navigate complex dynamics and drive alignment.
  • Execution-oriented with a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and blockers.
  • Adept at transforming incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable plans.
  • Demonstrated track record of shipping high-quality products on time.
  • Comfortable engaging in the commercial aspects of product development, including representing the product externally, setting expectations, and influencing outcomes that benefit both Affirm and its partners.
  • Bonus points: Experience in Fintech, Lending, ecommerce, or BNPL.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).
